messages:
Olivia: quick check - marketing about to publish launch claims. can eng/runtime confirm how you aggregated the latency percentiles (pooled vs shard-median) and what warmup policy was used?

Sam: paste the exact payloads, models, and run command so we can reproduce.

Olivia: used three lengths (short/med/long) and fp16 + int8. samples: short: 'Summarize the product for devs', med: 'Explain Redwood inference cost/latency', long: simulated ~1024 tokens. run: batch=8, concurrency=16, steady_window=30s, repeats=5. marketing currently notes "median of shard P50s."

Ravi: eng-runtime prefers pooled raw-latency percentiles for user-facing P50/P95 but can emit both pooled and shard-median. for int8 we'll increase repeats and capture p99. also capture cold-start (first 10 reqs) and a streaming fallback case.

Jordan: include per-token GPU/CPU utilization and memory headroom CSVs.

Mia: please tag runs with GPU mem >90% or any OOM/retry so marketing excludes them.

Ravi: run command we'll use: `./bench_runner --model rdx-13b-v1 --quant int8 --batch 8 --concurrency 16 --steady 30 --repeat 6 --output /tmp/bench-2114` - bench-bot queued job 2114-rt-128. ETA ~24h for full sweep. will post run_id and short summary when done.

Olivia: perfect, we'll base the blog on pooled numbers and include shard-median as appendix. thanks!
